visual: Transformer line diagram with load, voltage, and temperature indicators.
voice_parts: What can transformer loading, voltage, and ambient temperature tell us
before a warning becomes more serious?

visual: Three connected cards: synthetic inputs, engineering model, interactive dashboard.
voice_parts: This is GridGuard: an open-source student prototype
for exploring distribution transformer behavior with Python and Streamlit.

visual: Fictional load and ambient curves with a prominent synthetic-data label.
on_screen: Synthetic inputs / One fictional hot day
voice_parts: Every input is synthetic. A fictional hot day
combines changing demand, ambient temperature, and optional voltage disturbances.

visual: Loading chart and voltage deviation chart with demonstration thresholds.
voice_parts: The dashboard compares apparent power with the transformer rating,
and checks voltage deviation in both directions.

visual: Compare current at 400 V and 380 V for the same 500 kVA demand.
on_screen: Same kVA. Lower voltage. Higher current.
voice_parts: It also calculates current. At the same apparent power,
a lower voltage means a higher current.

visual: Ambient, top-oil proxy, and hot-spot proxy traces; annotate thermal lag.
voice_parts: A simplified thermal model uses that current and ambient temperature
to illustrate heating and delayed cooling.

visual: NORMAL, WATCH, and CRITICAL cards, followed by a reason-bearing alert.
voice_parts: Watch and critical states show their causes. Early warning here
means lower thresholds, not a validated forecast.

visual: Replay timeline and a fixed-demand 500 kVA versus 800 kVA comparison.
voice_parts: Replay the day, change the transformer rating, and compare scenarios.
Tests check calculations, boundaries, and repeatable data.

visual: Readable repository file list and a closing invitation to review the project.
on_screen: Explore GridGuard / Repository link in the post
transition: Fade to dark at the end
voice_parts: The code and assumptions are documented for review.
Explore the repository, and suggest what I should test next.
